target_customer: US consumers paying with bank accounts, and merchants paying lower fees than cards
problem: Paying directly from a bank account is cheaper for merchants than cards but offers consumers no rewards.
business_model: Pay by bank checkout with consumer rewards, revenue model not stated
product_category: Pay by bank and rewards fintech

founders.name: Arsh Shah Dilbagi
founders.background_notes: YC page lists adaline.ai as a current affiliation.

founders.name: Cole Bransford
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a former founder.

founders.name: Ryan Ozminkowski
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as founder and cofounder at Zage, Inc.

technical_complexity.rationale: Bank linking, payments rails and rewards engine in a regulated space, built by a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Open banking rails were available to all and rewards can be copied by funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pay by bank providers existed (Aeropay since 2017 per its own site); card networks supplied the rewards that Zage tried to match. No acquisition found.

market_need_then: PYMNTS research says card rewards train consumers to expect cashback, so pay by bank needs incentives; adoption stayed low.

branding.domain_note: Used tryzage.com and getzage, later zage.app (tryzage.com redirects there); GetZage, Inc. holds a ZAGE word mark registered June 2021 per Justia.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; only trademark records and the YC listing exist.

outcome_analysis: Zage raised a small seed round of about $130K per one database plus an undisclosed MPG Fund round, then the YC directory marks it Inactive and one cofounder is listed as former. No post-mortem, shutdown or acquisition report was found, so the cause is not public. Pay by bank without rewards had weak adoption and rewards were hard to fund against card economics, but that is context, not sourced cause.
notes: Both rounds rest on single databases (CB Insights, BounceWatch) with conflicting detail; CB Insights page itself returned 403 and was read via search summary. Competitor list empty: searches returned only undated vendor pages with nothing dated near mid 2021. Zage site tryzage.com redirects to zage.app which showed only the title. No shutdown source.
